s.note: the first steak through the pods tastes synthetic
s.how: Cut 600g sirloin into cubes and season well. Sear in a smoking pan in batches, then baste with 40g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme. Rest 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tbsp horseradish. Serve on toothpicks.

Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Roll out, cut rounds and prove 30 minutes. Fry at 175C for 90 seconds a side and toss in 100g caster sugar while warm.

m.note: everything Seth eats now needs sugar
m.how: Roast 1kg pork belly at 150C for 2 hours. Simmer 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger until syrupy. Slice the pork, brush with glaze and grill until sticky. Serve with 300g steamed rice and greens.

w.note: burnt sugar, the sweetest thing on the menu
w.how: Warm 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 6 yolks with 80g sugar and pour the cream over. Pour into 4 ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes. Chill overnight, sprinkle with sugar and torch until it cracks.

d.note: Seth spoons in sugar until it's syrup
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water so it's strong. Pour into four mugs and stir in sugar, two or three spoons each, more if you dare. Add milk only if you must.
